title: ScamWorld documents a recognition-to-action gap in web-agent fraud scenarios
summary: The study reports cases where agents recognized warning cues but still proceeded with the requested action in evaluated scenarios. This is a bounded agent-behavior benchmark; it does not provide or validate methods for committing fraud or establish outcomes in live services.
ai_technology: Six web-agent models were evaluated in controlled reconstructed websites; outcomes were classified from site event logs.
organization: Deakin University; Fudan University; The University of Melbourne; Amazon; Shanghai Innovation Institute
